benchmark_raw: FAILURE: Cannot locate tasks that match ':graph-age-benchmark:benchmark' as project 'graph-age-benchmark' not found in root project 'bluetape4k-graph'.

failure_analysis.what: Benchmark script scripts/benchmark-neo4j-age.sh failed because it invokes the Gradle task ':graph-age-benchmark:benchmark', but the project ':graph-age-benchmark' does not exist in this worktree. The script is sealed so we cannot fix it.
failure_analysis.why: The plan targeted only Neo4j suspend operations refactor. Compilation succeeded and all 30 :graph-neo4j tests (Neo4jGraphOperationsTest, Neo4jAlgorithmTest, Neo4jAlgorithmSuspendTest) pass, confirming the syncDelegate + withContext(Dispatchers.IO) refactor preserves behavior. However the sealed benchmark script references a non-existent Gradle project, producing no measurable benchmark_score.
failure_analysis.lesson: Sealed benchmark scripts may reference Gradle module names that no longer exist in the worktree (here: benchmark/graph-benchmark renamed or moved). Future rounds should either provide an alternative benchmark target, or the orchestrator should verify sealed scripts resolve to existing Gradle tasks before dispatch. Functional correctness of the refactor is confirmed via the full :graph-neo4j:test suite passing.
